brief:
Palestinian political actors confront mounting questions about whether legislative elections will proceed as scheduled or face postponement or cancellation, Shehab Wire reported. The uncertainty reflects apparent efforts to prepare public opinion for possible delays or abandonment of the vote.

Three Palestinian factions have reportedly begun signaling reservations about the electoral timeline, though the specifics of their positions remain unclear from available reporting. The question of whether elections will advance or stall has emerged as a central point of contention in Palestinian political circles.
dek: Palestinian political actors confront mounting questions about whether legislative elections will proceed as scheduled or face postponement or cancellation, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Palestinian factions face uncertainty over legislative elections timing
